arguments.name: districtCode
arguments.description: District code to locate the record (exact match). Recommended.

raw.name: districtCode
raw.description: District code to locate the record (exact match). Recommended.

arguments.name: districtName
arguments.description: District name to locate the record (partial match). Used if code not provided.

raw.name: districtName
raw.description: District name to locate the record (partial match). Used if code not provided.

arguments.name: provinceName
arguments.description:
Province name to narrow down the search (partial match). Optional.
If both provinceCode and provinceName are provided, provinceCode takes priority

raw.name: provinceName
raw.description:
Province name to narrow down the search (partial match). Optional.
If both provinceCode and provinceName are provided, provinceCode takes priority

arguments.description: New district name to set in ctl00$body$txtName.

raw.description: New district name to set in ctl00$body$txtName.

arguments.description: New province code to select in ctl00$body$dpcountry (preferred for reliability). Example: "000001".

raw.name: newProvinceCode
raw.description: New province code to select in ctl00$body$dpcountry (preferred for reliability). Example: "000001".

arguments.name: newProvinceName
arguments.description: Province name to select (tool will find matching <option> by text, case-insensitive). Use if you don’t know the code.

raw.name: newProvinceName
